about.title: Rolling Hills Estates Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Rolling Hills Estates is a quiet, hillside community, but its winding corridors — Palos Verdes Drive N, Palos Verdes Drive E, Hawthorne Boulevard, and Silver Spur Road — still see their share of collisions. Public records show 15 injury collisions and 19 injured people in the most recent final crash year, with a concentration of reports on Thursday afternoons between noon and 2 p.m. When a crash happens here, the aftermath can feel disorienting: medical appointments, insurance calls, missed work, and a car that may not be drivable. LawProactive doesn't practice law — we're a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney working under Los Angeles County and California rules. That attorney can help you understand your options, deal with insurance adjusters, and work toward fair compensation for what you've been through. There's no cost to reach out and no obligation to move forward if you're not ready.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Talking to the Insurer

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury lawsuit in California, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity was involved (for example, a road defect claim). An attorney can help make sure you don't miss a deadline you didn't know existed.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Cut Both Ways
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly responsible for the crash — but your share of fault reduces your payout. Early, careful documentation of how the accident happened matters, especially on multi-lane roads like Hawthorne Boulevard.

items.title: No Cap on Pain and Suffering, No Fee Unless You Win
items.desc: California doesn't limit non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases, and attorneys in our network work on contingency — meaning there's no fee unless you recover. That structure lets you focus on recovery instead of legal bills.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim later. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What should I do if my crash happened on Palos Verdes Drive or Silver Spur Road?
items.answer: Try to document the scene with photos, note the time and weather conditions, and get contact information from any witnesses if it's safe to do so. Since these corridors see regular reported collisions, preserving evidence quickly — skid marks, signal timing, road conditions — can matter for your claim. An attorney can also help request any available traffic camera or maintenance records.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge me anything to find an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects injured people with independent personal injury attorneys in California. Attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation.
